body.content:
Everyone told me: "Study Computer Science, it's the future."
But nobody really told me how the first month would feel. 👀

In week 1, you think you are about to build the next Instagram.
By week 3, you are still wondering why the loop isn't stopping? 😶

And then, suddenly, something clicks.

One problem.
Solved by you.

And from that moment, you get hooked !

I am Abdallah, a first-year Computer Science student.

I am not an expert. I am still on the path — just like many of you.

Here, I will share:
→ the concepts I am learning.
→ the mistakes I make.
→ the lessons nobody teaches in class.

This is for every student who was told:

"CS is too hard"
or
"this is not for people like us."

We are here to prove that wrong. Together. 💪

This is Day 1 of my public journey.

Follow along if you are on the same road. 🚀
